description_en: Modifies the IP whitelist group of an instance by calling ModifyIpWhitelist
description_zh: 调用ModifyIpWhitelist修改实例的分组白名单
kebab_example: aliyun hbase modify-ip-whitelist --cluster-id ld-bp1uoihlf82e80000 --group-name group_01 --ip-version 4 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIpWhitelist

parameters.help_en: The ID of target instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html to obtain target instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses in the whitelist group after modification. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 修改后分组白名单的IP地址，如果有多个IP地址，您可以使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist group for the target instance. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144606.html to obtain the whitelist group name
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例的白名单分组名称，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144606.html接口获取
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The version of the IP address. Valid values:

4: IPv4.
6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
IP地址的版本类型，取值：

4：表示IP地址的版本类型为IPv4。
6：表示IP地址的版本类型为IPv6
parameters.name: ip_version
